cards.title: Steady-State NCA Metrics
cards.claim: Steady-state analysis requires a defined dosing interval (Tau). Key parameters include Cavg (AUC_TAU/Tau), Ctau (concentration at end of interval), and Accumulation Index. Fluctuation% and Swing are calculated based on Cmax and Cmin/Ctau within the interval.
limitations: Cmin and Ctau may differ depending on regulatory definitions; both are output.
AUC_TAU calculation handles small sampling deviations by estimating concentration at Tau.
cards.downstream_use: Exposure-response analysis for multiple-dose regimens; PK/PD index calculation (e.g., AUC/MIC, Cmax/MIC).

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
